description: Soft crossfade between two clips. Half-second blend reads as 'invisible' to viewer — used for connecting beats inside the same emotional unit.

ffmpeg_params.offset_clip_a_minus_0.5: Set offset = duration(clip_a) - 0.5 (overlap window starts here)

audio_recipe: afade out 0.5s on clip_a (last 0.5s) + afade in 0.5s on clip_b (first 0.5s). acrossfade=d=0.5 handles both simultaneously.
use_cases: Between narrative beats inside the same scene
Image variants A→B→C of the same shot
Subtle cut when no emotional rupture intended
Connecting two motion AI clips that share continuity
avoid_for: Scene changes with hard emotional shift (use hard-cut-with-whoosh)
hyperframes_alternative: GSAP timeline: tl.to(clipA, {opacity:0, duration:0.5}, 'tBeat').to(clipB, {opacity:1, duration:0.5}, 'tBeat'). Use when transitions must be rendered inline in HyperFrames composition rather than pre-baked ffmpeg.
validated_notes: Crossfades 0.4-0.6s observed in 6/10 F1 canonical referents as inter-beat connector. Always paired with subtle audio acrossfade — never video-only.
